prompt_text: I need a dental implant in Dallas. Which specific dental practices should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — to give specific practices with phone numbers, addresses and reasons to call I need one quick detail: what zip code or neighborhood in Dallas are you in (or are you willing to travel across the metro area)? Also: is this a single-tooth implant, multiple implants/full-arch, and do you have dental insurance?

While you reply, here’s useful guidance and what I’ll look for when I pick specific offices for you:

Which type of provider to call (and why)
- Periodontist or oral & maxillofacial surgeon for implant placement — they have advanced surgical training and manage complications, bone grafting and extractions.  
- Prosthodontist for complex restorations or full-mouth rehabilitation — they specialize in the tooth replacement/restoration piece (abutments and crowns).  
- Implant specialty centers that coordinate surgery + restoration can be convenient if you want one place to handle everything.

What I will prioritize when selecting practices
- Board-certified specialists (ABOMS for oral surgeons, American Board of Periodontology, American College of Prosthodontists).  
- Experience with dental implants (number of years, full-arch or complex cases if that’s relevant).  
- Use of CBCT/3D imaging and guided implant planning (better accuracy).  
- Clear treatment planning (written estimate, timeline, alternatives).  
- Good patient reviews and before/after photos.  
- Sedation options if you need it, and clear cost/financing options.  
- Communication and aftercare (warranty/guarantee policies, follow-up).

What to ask when you call (so you can compare offices)
- Which specialist will place the implant and will they handle the crown or coordinate with a restorative dentist?  
- Do you use CBCT 3D imaging and do you provide a treatment plan with timelines?  
- How many implants of this type do you place per year (or per month)?  
- What brands of implants do you use? Do you offer guided surgery or same-day (immediate) implants?  
- Expected total cost breakdown (implant, abutment, crown, grafts) and financing/insurance policies.  
- Do you handle bone grafting or sinus lifts if needed? What is the typical healing timeline?  
- Do you have patient photos/references for similar cases?

Costs & timeline (quick expectations)
- Single implant + abutment + crown commonly ranges widely (ask office for a written estimate).  
- Typical process: consult + CBCT → implant placement → 3–6 months healing (depending on bone) → abutment/crown. Some offices offer immediate or same-day implants in select cases.

If you give your neighborhood/zip code and treatment details I’ll pull together 4–6 specific, well-vetted Dallas-area practices to call and explain why each one is a good fit for you.
